cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've tightened the tap joint. Open it slowly before I start the washing-up; a full blast tells us very little.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the apron on and turn it halfway. I'll observe the joint from here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The observer needs to know where the repair is. Apron first, please, then your hand on the tap. We are testing one change at a time.
